affected_callers: V9 no_skill, old_skill, and new_skill cleanup experiment conditions

acceptance_criteria.condition: All experiment conditions have identical editable scope and deletion policy; only Skill availability and snapshot content differ.

invariants: The planned treatment contrast changes only the supplied frozen Skill, not allowed edits or task rules.
The no_skill condition cannot read a globally installed or supplied Skill.
A result remains not_run until every preregistered trial completes under the frozen protocol.

remove: condition-specific scope wording that confounded Skill availability with allowed file types

documentation_synchronization.evidence: The parity regression checks every frozen prompt.

safeguards.name: condition parity
safeguards.rationale: A dedicated regression rejects a Python-only baseline or a Skill-specific deletion rule.

safeguards.name: frozen isolation
safeguards.rationale: The no_skill prompt explicitly prohibits all Skill reads while treatment prompts name only their supplied snapshot.

design_boundary.rationale: Prompt text owns experimental framing and the runner test owns parity verification.

data_ownership.rationale: No mutable business data is involved.

error_model.rationale: Prompt drift is a deterministic test failure rather than an implicit protocol change.

contract_evolution.rationale: The frozen V13 envelope is delayed until its conditions share a common task contract.

threat_boundary.rationale: No-skill isolation still prohibits global Skill discovery or reads.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The correction is separately verified and committed before preregistration.

configuration_secrets.rationale: No secret or runtime configuration changed.

operational_knowledge.rationale: The evaluation reference now states the required condition parity.

reproducibility.rationale: The frozen prompt files and parity test reproduce the same condition boundary.
